```
[2026-03-12T10:15:22Z] inference: kvcache miss spike -> latency=800ms path=/v1/generate
```

sam: agree with toggle approach. prefer hotfix and resume canary at lower percent (5%) to validate
sam: @deploy-bot resume canary with override patch=hotfix/rc4-kv-prefetch-disable pr=3456 target_canary=5% requested_by=@sam

tara: reranker smoke PASS. gen workload within expected latency envelope. no 5xx observed in the window
ci-check: quick eval run: latency median 120ms, p95 310ms — within thresholds
deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETE · env=staging · tag=ignite/v2.9.0-rc4 · final_rollout=100% · duration=18m · commit=3adf9b2 · artifacts=s3://redwood-builds/ignite/v2.9.0-rc4 · initiated_by=@sam
sam: thanks all. note: we'll keep kv prefetch disabled by default until performance tuned. pinning for next prod-change-window unless we see regressions
mike: adding release-note bullet: "Temporarily disable kv prefetch in ignite v2.9.0-rc4 due to kvcache miss-induced latency spike" :memo: :tada:
